svg.text: Every linear map from space to the number line corresponds to a unique vector; applying it equals dotting with that vector.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dotting with a unit vector gives the projection's length; with a general vector, multiply by that vector's length as well.
